metadata.agent_last_message:
All 11 point formats render correctly with exact record lengths and binary-identical round-trips.

The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

**`output/main.js`** - Entry point handling CLI args, request dispatch, error handling, and exit codes.

**`output/shared.js`** - Constants (header size 375, VLR header 54, EVLR header 60, all 11 point format min sizes) and utilities for string I/O, GUID encoding, extra-bytes value serialization, and error constructors.

**`output/inspect.js`** - Parses LAS 1.4 binary into the JSON dataset schema. Validates header fields, global encoding bits, legacy field rules for formats 6-10, and structurally validates all LASF_Spec and LASF_Projection VLR/EVLR records (classification lookup length, extra bytes multiple of 192, waveform descriptor length, GeoKeyDirectory consistency, GeoDoubleParams alignment).

**`output/render.js`** - Serializes a JSON dataset into LAS 1.4 binary. Recomputes all derived header fields (offset_to_point_data, record lengths, extents, point counts by return, legacy counts, EVLR/waveform offsets). Handles all VLR kinds including opaque, classification lookup, text area, extra bytes, waveform descriptors/data, GeoTIFF keys, and WKT records.
